properties.title: Exact duplicate sidewalk
properties.label: A - Exact duplicate sidewalk
properties.setup: Identical sidewalk in both datasets; the DS1 and DS2 end nodes carry different tactile_paving values.
properties.expected: Coincident ends join; the DS2 copy is removed as a duplicate. The end node keeps DS1's tactile_paving=no, gains DS2-only ext:surface, and audits DS2's 'yes'.

properties.title: Drifting near-parallel sidewalk
properties.label: B - Drifting near-parallel sidewalk
properties.setup: DS2 sidewalk 0.4-1.2 m off the DS1 sidewalk, not quite parallel.
properties.expected: Its ends snap onto the DS1 ends and it is removed as a duplicate.

properties.title: Road x crossing
properties.label: C - Road x crossing
properties.setup: DS1 road crossed by a DS2 crossing, no node where they meet.
properties.expected: road-crossing (point) makes one node where they cross; road and crossing each split in two.

properties.title: Two kerbs 2.5 m apart
properties.label: D - Two kerbs 2.5 m apart
properties.setup: Each dataset has a sidewalk ending in a kerb; the kerbs are 2.5 m apart.
properties.expected: Kerbs never merge with each other. At 1 m both sidewalks and kerbs remain. At 3 m the DS2 sidewalk is removed as a duplicate and its kerb goes with it (open design question).

properties.title: Road and sidewalk 1.5 m apart
properties.label: E - Road and sidewalk 1.5 m apart
properties.setup: DS1 road with a DS2 sidewalk running alongside, inside proximity.
properties.expected: Both kept and not connected: no default rule joins a road and a sidewalk.

properties.title: Living street vs sidewalk
properties.label: F - Living street vs sidewalk
properties.setup: Two living streets 0.5 m apart, plus a DS2 sidewalk 3 m away.
properties.expected: The living streets merge into one; the sidewalk stays separate.

properties.title: Short T-stub onto a span
properties.label: G - Short T-stub onto a span
properties.setup: 1.2 m DS2 stub meeting the MIDDLE of a long DS1 sidewalk (no node there).
properties.expected: The angle guard keeps the stub (it crosses, it does not run alongside). pedestrian-pedestrian splits the DS1 sidewalk where the stub ends on it.

properties.title: Endpoints 0.36 m apart
properties.label: H - Endpoints 0.36 m apart
properties.setup: DS2 sidewalk starts 0.36 m from the end of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: The DS2 end snaps onto the DS1 node; the node keeps DS1's attributes and gains DS2-only ones.

properties.title: Road only in DS2
properties.label: I - Road only in DS2
properties.setup: Service road present only in DS2.
properties.expected: Kept unchanged — nothing to merge with.

properties.title: DS1 spur ends on a DS2 span
properties.label: J - DS1 spur ends on a DS2 span
properties.setup: DS1 spur ends on the middle of a long DS2 sidewalk.
properties.expected: pedestrian-pedestrian splits the DS2 sidewalk at the spur's end; all three pieces meet there.

properties.title: Plain footway duplicate
properties.label: K - Plain footway duplicate
properties.setup: Two plain footways (highway=footway, no subtype) 0.4 m apart.
properties.expected: Merged into one.

properties.title: Crossing ending on a road node
properties.label: L - Crossing ending on a road node
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends EXACTLY on an existing mid node of a DS1 road.
properties.expected: The coincident nodes join and the existing node is reused — no new node. The road is split there; the crossing joins it.

properties.title: Duplicate crossing
properties.label: M - Duplicate crossing
properties.setup: Identical crossing in both datasets.
properties.expected: Merged into one.

properties.title: Sidewalk - footway - crossing chain
properties.label: N - Sidewalk - footway - crossing chain
properties.setup: DS1 sidewalk and plain-footway connector; DS2 crossing continuing the chain at the same coordinate.
properties.expected: One continuous route: the coincident footway and crossing ends join (snap coincident).

properties.title: Duplicate with a crossing attached
properties.label: P - Duplicate with a crossing attached
properties.setup: DS2 duplicate sidewalk with a DS2 crossing hanging off its end.
properties.expected: The duplicate's ends snap onto the DS1 ends, taking the crossing along; the duplicate is removed and the crossing stays connected.

properties.title: Three-segment chain between two DS1 ends
properties.label: Q - Three-segment chain between two DS1 ends
properties.setup: DS2 chain of three sidewalk segments bridging two DS1 sidewalks.
properties.expected: One continuous route end to end; all four junctions connect.

properties.title: Mid-span duplicate with a spur
properties.label: R - Mid-span duplicate with a spur
properties.setup: DS2 duplicate along the middle of a DS1 sidewalk, with a DS2 spur off its end.
properties.expected: The duplicate is removed; pedestrian-pedestrian then joins the spur's end to the DS1 sidewalk with a connector, so the stranding guard has nothing to restore.

properties.title: T onto a DS1 span
properties.label: S - T onto a DS1 span
properties.setup: DS2 sidewalk ends 0.2 m from the middle of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: The DS1 sidewalk gets a node and is split there; a connector joins the DS2 end to it.

properties.title: Partial overlap
properties.label: U - Partial overlap
properties.setup: DS2 sidewalk 2 m off a DS1 sidewalk, continuing 45 m past its end.
properties.expected: Kept whole and not connected at 1 m and 3 m: about 52% of it overlaps (below 80%), dedup never trims an edge, and the ends run alongside the other line, so no T junction (angle guard). Changed from 4.x, which split and half-removed it at 3 m.

properties.title: Duplicate, surfaces differ
properties.label: V - Duplicate, surfaces differ
properties.setup: Identical sidewalk in both datasets; DS1 tagged surface=concrete, DS2 surface=asphalt.
properties.expected: One sidewalk: the DS2 copy is a duplicate whatever its tags.

properties.title: Coincident kerb, attributes differ
properties.label: W - Coincident kerb, attributes differ
properties.setup: DS1 and DS2 sidewalks meet at a kerb node present in both; DS2's copy adds tactile_paving=yes.
properties.expected: The coincident kerbs join (kerbs only ever join when coincident): one node joining both sidewalks, keeping DS1's tags, gaining tactile_paving=yes and auditing it.

properties.title: Crossing ends on a sidewalk, next to a corner
properties.label: X1 - Crossing ends on a sidewalk, next to a corner
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends on the span of a DS1 sidewalk, 0.6 m below the sidewalk's corner node.
properties.expected: crossing-sidewalk splits the sidewalk at the crossing end (gap 0, no connector); nothing moves and the corner stays as it is.

properties.title: Same, datasets swapped
properties.label: X2 - Same, datasets swapped
properties.setup: DS1 crossing ends on the span of a DS2 sidewalk, 0.6 m below the DS2 sidewalk's corner node.
properties.expected: The DS2 sidewalk is split at the DS1 crossing end; the DS2 corner stays as the corner.

properties.title: Kerb on a sidewalk span
properties.label: X3 - Kerb on a sidewalk span
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends in a kerb lying exactly on the span of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: The sidewalk is split at the kerb; the kerb keeps its position and joins sidewalk and crossing.

properties.title: Kerb 0.4 m short of a sidewalk span
properties.label: X4 - Kerb 0.4 m short of a sidewalk span
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends in a kerb 0.4 m short of the span of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: The kerb never moves. The sidewalk gets a node and is split there; a 0.4 m connector joins the kerb to it. The sidewalk keeps its shape (4.x bent it to the kerb).

properties.title: Kerb 0.4 m beyond a sidewalk end
properties.label: X5 - Kerb 0.4 m beyond a sidewalk end
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends in a kerb 0.4 m beyond the end of a DS1 sidewalk, in line with it.
properties.expected: Connected: a connector joins the kerb to the sidewalk's end node (4.x left them apart). The kerb does not move.

properties.title: Crossing end 0.4 m beyond a sidewalk end
properties.label: X6 - Crossing end 0.4 m beyond a sidewalk end
properties.setup: As X5, but the crossing end is a bare node.
properties.expected: A connector joins the crossing end to the sidewalk's end node; neither moves.

properties.title: Sidewalk ends 0.4 m short of a DS1 kerb
properties.label: X7 - Sidewalk ends 0.4 m short of a DS1 kerb
properties.setup: DS1 crossing ends in a kerb; a DS2 sidewalk ends 0.4 m short of it.
properties.expected: A connector joins the kerb to the sidewalk end. The kerb keeps its position and its tags.

properties.title: Crossing ends on a plain footway
properties.label: X8 - Crossing ends on a plain footway
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends on the span of a DS1 plain footway (highway=footway, no subtype).
properties.expected: Not joined: no default rule joins a crossing to a plain footway (add one to get it).

properties.title: Two crossings 0.3 m apart on a sidewalk
properties.label: X9 - Two crossings 0.3 m apart on a sidewalk
properties.setup: Two DS2 crossings end 0.3 m apart on the span of the same DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: The sidewalk is split at each crossing end in one pass: three pieces, two junctions.

properties.title: Crossing junction near a sidewalk corner
properties.label: X10 - Crossing junction near a sidewalk corner
properties.setup: DS2 sidewalk bends round a corner as one line. DS1 crossings meet at a junction 2.6 m from the corner; one of them ends exactly on the corner.
properties.expected: The coincident corner nodes join and the DS2 sidewalk is split there. The junction 2.6 m away never joins the sidewalk: a crossing at it already reaches the corner (nearer end only).

properties.title: Same, datasets swapped
properties.label: X11 - Same, datasets swapped
properties.setup: DS1 sidewalk bends round a corner as one line. DS2 crossings meet at a junction 2.6 m from the corner; one of them ends exactly on the corner.
properties.expected: The DS1 sidewalk is split at the corner, where the crossing joins it. The junction keeps its position; no crossing collapses.

properties.title: Sidewalk vertex beside a crossing (real data)
properties.label: X12 - Sidewalk vertex beside a crossing (real data)
properties.setup: DS1 sidewalk bends round a corner as one line, with a vertex S 2.3 m west. DS2 crossings: A on the corner, junction B 0.6 m east, an east crossing with a bend 2.7 m from the corner, and a south crossing passing 2.3 m from S.
properties.expected: The sidewalk is split only at the corner, where crossing A-B ends. No crossing is cut or moved.

properties.title: Same, datasets swapped
properties.label: X13 - Same, datasets swapped
properties.setup: As X12 with the datasets swapped: DS1 crossings, DS2 sidewalk.
properties.expected: The sidewalk is split only at the corner, where crossing A-B ends. No crossing is cut or moved.

properties.title: Crossing ends on a living street
properties.label: LS1 - Crossing ends on a living street
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends on the span of a DS1 living street.
properties.expected: crossing-living-street splits the living street where the crossing ends.

properties.title: Same, datasets swapped
properties.label: LS2 - Same, datasets swapped
properties.setup: DS1 crossing ends on the span of a DS2 living street.
properties.expected: The DS2 living street is split at the DS1 crossing end.

properties.title: Crossing end 0.4 m beyond a living street end
properties.label: LS3 - Crossing end 0.4 m beyond a living street end
properties.setup: A bare DS2 crossing end lies 0.4 m beyond the end of a DS1 living street, in line with it.
properties.expected: A connector joins the crossing end to the living street's end node.

properties.title: Living street 0.4 m short of a crossing end
properties.label: LS4 - Living street 0.4 m short of a crossing end
properties.setup: A DS2 living street ends 0.4 m short of a bare DS1 crossing end.
properties.expected: A connector joins the DS1 crossing end to the living street end; neither moves.

properties.title: Kerb 0.4 m short of a living street
properties.label: LS5 - Kerb 0.4 m short of a living street
properties.setup: DS2 crossing ends in a kerb 0.4 m short of the span of a DS1 living street.
properties.expected: The kerb never moves. The living street gets a node and is split; a connector joins the kerb.

properties.title: Junction near a living street corner
properties.label: LS6 - Junction near a living street corner
properties.setup: DS2 living street bends round a corner as one line. DS1 crossings meet at a junction 2.6 m from the corner; one of them ends exactly on the corner.
properties.expected: The living street is split only at the corner. The junction stays 2.6 m away.

properties.title: Same, datasets swapped
properties.label: LS7 - Same, datasets swapped
properties.setup: DS1 living street bends round a corner as one line. DS2 crossings meet at a junction 2.6 m from the corner; one of them ends exactly on the corner.
properties.expected: The living street is split at the corner and the crossing joins it there; the junction keeps its position.

properties.title: Sidewalks meeting a living street
properties.label: LS8 - Sidewalks meeting a living street
properties.setup: One DS2 sidewalk ends on the span of a DS1 living street; another ends 0.4 m beyond its end.
properties.expected: Not joined: no default rule joins a sidewalk and a living street.

properties.title: Sidewalk ends 2.5 m apart
properties.label: SN1 - Sidewalk ends 2.5 m apart
properties.setup: A DS2 sidewalk starts 2.5 m beyond a DS1 sidewalk's end.
properties.expected: custom_snap: the 3 m sidewalk rule snaps them. Default: apart at 1 m, snapped at 3 m.

properties.title: Crossing ends 2 m apart
properties.label: SN2 - Crossing ends 2 m apart
properties.setup: A DS2 crossing starts 2 m beyond a DS1 crossing's end.
properties.expected: custom_snap: beyond the 1.5 m crossing rule, so apart. Default: apart at 1 m, snapped at 3 m.

properties.title: Corners 2 m apart: first rule decides
properties.label: SN3 - Corners 2 m apart: first rule decides
properties.setup: Two corners 2 m apart, each where a sidewalk and a crossing meet (DS1 and DS2).
properties.expected: custom_snap: both corners match the crossing rule (listed first, 1.5 m) and the sidewalk rule (3 m). The first rule both match governs, so they stay apart.

properties.title: Plain footway ends 0.4 m apart
properties.label: SN4 - Plain footway ends 0.4 m apart
properties.setup: A DS2 plain footway starts 0.4 m beyond a DS1 plain footway's end.
properties.expected: custom_snap: no rule lists footways, so 'others' (0.5 m) applies: snapped.

properties.title: Plain footway ends 0.7 m apart
properties.label: SN5 - Plain footway ends 0.7 m apart
properties.setup: A DS2 plain footway starts 0.7 m beyond a DS1 plain footway's end.
properties.expected: custom_snap: beyond 'others' (0.5 m), so apart. Default (1 m, 3 m): snapped.

properties.title: Footway and crossing ends at one coordinate
properties.label: SN6 - Footway and crossing ends at one coordinate
properties.setup: A DS1 plain footway ends exactly where a DS2 crossing starts.
properties.expected: Joined by 'coincident', whatever their types. With snap off they stay two nodes.

properties.title: DS2 anchor: the DS1 end moves
properties.label: AN1 - DS2 anchor: the DS1 end moves
properties.setup: Sidewalk ends 0.4 m apart; DS1's end node tactile_paving=no, DS2's tactile_paving=yes.
properties.expected: custom_anchor (sidewalks anchored on DS2): the DS1 end moves onto the DS2 node, which keeps its position and tactile_paving=yes; DS1's 'no' is audited. No node is left at the DS1 position.

properties.title: anchor_only: DS2 values audited, not added
properties.label: AN2 - anchor_only: DS2 values audited, not added
properties.setup: Crossing ends 0.3 m apart; DS1's end has ext:note, DS2's has ext:lit.
properties.expected: custom_anchor (crossings, attributes anchor_only): the DS2 end snaps onto DS1's; the node keeps ext:note, does not gain ext:lit, and audits it.

properties.title: DS2 anchor: the DS1 duplicate goes
properties.label: AN3 - DS2 anchor: the DS1 duplicate goes
properties.setup: The same sidewalk in both datasets, 0.3 m apart.
properties.expected: custom_anchor: DS1's ends move onto DS2's, then dedup (anchored on DS2) removes the DS1 copy.

properties.title: O1: two rules match the same spot
properties.label: CC1 - O1: two rules match the same spot
properties.setup: A DS2 crossing ends 0.5 m short of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: kerbed-crossing (listed first) takes it: a node on the sidewalk tagged barrier=kerb, kerb=lowered and ext:survey_batch, and a connector carrying ext:barrier and ext:kerb (not edge keys). The broader footway-sidewalk rule skips it.

properties.title: The broader rule catches a plain footway
properties.label: CC2 - The broader rule catches a plain footway
properties.setup: A DS2 plain footway ends 0.5 m short of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: Only footway-sidewalk matches: its node carries ext:source=rule2.

properties.title: O2: a later rule meets an earlier node
properties.label: CC3 - O2: a later rule meets an earlier node
properties.setup: kerbed-crossing makes node J on a sidewalk; a footway ends 0.78 m from J (0.6 m from the span).
properties.expected: footway-sidewalk reuses J rather than making a second node beside it. J lists both rules and keeps kerbed-crossing's tags.

properties.title: O3: a created connector is never cut
properties.label: CC4 - O3: a created connector is never cut
properties.setup: kerbed-crossing's 0.8 m connector crosses a DS1 road lying 0.4 m off the sidewalk.
properties.expected: The later road-crossing rule does not split the connector, and the crossing itself stops 0.4 m short of the road (beyond road-crossing's 0.3 m): the road stays whole.

properties.title: Point rule: a crossing and a near miss
properties.label: CC5 - Point rule: a crossing and a near miss
properties.setup: One DS2 crossing crosses a DS1 road; another stops 0.2 m short of it.
properties.expected: road-crossing (point, 0.3 m) makes a node at each, tagged tactile_paving=yes; the near miss gets a connector.

properties.title: G1: a crossing on a bridge
properties.label: CC6 - G1: a crossing on a bridge
properties.setup: A DS2 crossing tagged bridge=yes, layer=1 passes over a DS1 road.
properties.expected: Never joined: lines whose layer or bridge differ do not meet, even where they cross on the map.

properties.title: Sidewalk T onto a sidewalk
properties.label: CC7 - Sidewalk T onto a sidewalk
properties.setup: A DS2 sidewalk ends 0.6 m short of the span of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: sidewalk-sidewalk: the DS1 sidewalk gets a node and is split; a connector joins the DS2 end.

properties.title: W5: a near-parallel end is not a T
properties.label: CC8 - W5: a near-parallel end is not a T
properties.setup: A DS2 sidewalk runs 0.6-0.9 m off a DS1 sidewalk, nearly parallel, both ends within 1 m of it.
properties.expected: No junction: an end running alongside B is not a T (angle under 30°). Overlap is dedup's job; at 0.5 m buffer it does not count as a duplicate.

properties.title: W2: nearest B only
properties.label: CC9 - W2: nearest B only
properties.setup: A DS2 crossing end lies 0.4 m from one DS1 sidewalk and 0.9 m from another.
properties.expected: One junction, to the nearer sidewalk; never a fan of connectors.

properties.title: W3: two ends facing across a gap
properties.label: CC10 - W3: two ends facing across a gap
properties.setup: A DS1 sidewalk end and a DS2 sidewalk end 0.57 m apart, each nearest the other's end.
properties.expected: Both ends qualify under sidewalk-sidewalk, but only one connector is made.

properties.title: W4: nearer end only
properties.label: CC11 - W4: nearer end only
properties.setup: A 0.75 m DS2 sidewalk stub whose ends are 0.2 m and 0.95 m from a DS1 sidewalk span.
properties.expected: Only the nearer end joins, so the stub cannot fold onto the sidewalk.

properties.title: G3: DS1 × DS1 left as authored
properties.label: CC12 - G3: DS1 × DS1 left as authored
properties.setup: A DS1 crossing ends 0.5 m short of a DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: Untouched: connect rules act on DS1 × DS2 pairs only. Gaps inside a dataset are self-merge's job.

properties.title: W1: one rule, two matches on one sidewalk
properties.label: CC13 - W1: one rule, two matches on one sidewalk
properties.setup: Two DS2 crossings end 0.5 m and 0.4 m short of the same DS1 sidewalk.
properties.expected: Both junctions are made in one pass; the sidewalk is split twice.

properties.title: An end that overshoots B
properties.label: CC14 - An end that overshoots B
properties.setup: A DS2 crossing crosses a DS1 sidewalk and ends 0.4 m beyond it.
properties.expected: The crossing meets the sidewalk where it crosses it: one node there, the sidewalk and the crossing both split (a 0.4 m crossing stub remains), no connector.

properties.title: Stranding guard restores a duplicate
properties.label: DG1 - Stranding guard restores a duplicate
properties.setup: A DS2 sidewalk 0.5 m off a DS1 sidewalk, its ends 4 m beyond snap reach; a DS2 footway hangs off its west end.
properties.expected: Dedup removes the DS2 sidewalk, but nothing connects the footway to DS1, so after connect the stranding guard restores it: the footway stays connected to it.

properties.title: Duplicate drawn with different segmentation
properties.label: DG2 - Duplicate drawn with different segmentation
properties.setup: DS1 draws a sidewalk as two edges (a node mid-way); DS2 draws it as one edge 0.3 m off.
properties.expected: DS2's ends snap onto DS1's ends. Both ends are then on the anchor network, and the two DS1 edges inside its buffer already join them, so the DS2 copy is a duplicate and is removed (connectivity guard, refined in the 5.0 build: it keeps only an edge that adds a connection).

properties.title: Points: same type merges, other types do not
properties.label: E1 - Points: same type merges, other types do not
properties.setup: A bench in both datasets 0.3 m apart (ext:color green / red), and a DS2 pole 0.5 m away.
properties.expected: The benches merge at DS1's position, DS1's colour kept and DS2's audited; the pole stays.

properties.title: Lines: the same fence
properties.label: E2 - Lines: the same fence
properties.setup: The same fence line in both datasets 0.3 m apart; DS2 adds ext:height.
properties.expected: One line: DS1's geometry, gaining ext:height.

properties.title: Polygons: the same building, plus a kiosk
properties.label: E3 - Polygons: the same building, plus a kiosk
properties.setup: The same building in both datasets (0.5 m shift; DS2 adds ext:levels) and a DS2-only kiosk.
properties.expected: Two polygons: the building (DS1 geometry, gaining ext:levels) and the kiosk.

properties.title: Zones: the same pedestrian zone
properties.label: E4 - Zones: the same pedestrian zone
properties.setup: The same pedestrian zone in both datasets, 0.2 m apart.
properties.expected: One zone (DS1's); its _w_id lists output nodes.
